claim.excerpt: In our hands, the observed PGB values showed a decline consistent with the known pharmacokinetics of pregabalin, which displays rapid absorption, with peak levels reached within 1.5 h (up to 3 hours with food), high oral bioavailability, negligible metabolism, and almost exclusive renal elimination.

sources.title: Case Report: High-dose pregabalin ingestion in an adolescent: clinical course and serial plasma concentrations.

why_it_matters: Metabolic pathway statements support interpretation of parent/metabolite findings.
